==Biography==
Fabián Esteban Llanos Bernal is from Santiago, Chile.

=== 2016 Season===
His debut was in [[Hafnet eSports]] as Mid Laner participating in the [[LAS 2016 Opening Cup]] where the team was fifth in the tournament. At mid-year [[Warangelus]] he remains in the team but as AD Carry participating in the [[LAS 2016 Closing Cup]] where the team was fourth in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[LAS 2016 Closing Cup Playoffs]] the team was fourth in the tournament losing against [[Isurus]] 1-3, at the end of the tournament he leaves the team.

=== 2017 Season===
At the beginning of the year he joins [[Just Toys Havoks]] as AD Carry participating in the [[LLN 2017 Opening]] where the team was second in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[LLN 2017 Opening Playoffs]] the team reached the final facing [[Lyon Gaming (2013 Latin American Team)|Lyon Gaming]] losing 0-3, at the end of the tournament he leaves the team due to visa problems.

=== 2018 Season===
At the beginning of the year he joins [[Rebirth eSports]] as AD Carry participating in the [[CLS 2018 Opening]] where the team was first in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2018 Opening Playoffs]] the team reached the final facing [[Kaos Latin Gamers|KLG]] losing 2-3. At mid-year [[Warangelus]] he remains in the team participating in the [[CLS 2018 Closing]] where the team was second in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2018 Closing Playoffs]] the team reached the final again facing [[Kaos Latin Gamers|KLG]] losing 1-3, at the end of the tournament he leaves the team.

=== 2019 Season===
At the beginning of the year he joins [[Isurus]] as AD Carry participating in the [[LLA 2019 Opening]] where the team was fourth in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[LLA 2019 Opening Playoffs]] the team reaches the final facing [[Rainbow7]] winning 3-1, qualifying for the first time to an international tournament. Already in the MSI the team was in group A facing [[Phong Vũ Buffalo]] from Vietnam, [[1907 Fenerbahçe]] from Turkey and [[Bombers]] from Oceania, the team was last in the group stage together with [[Bombers]]. At mid-year [[Warangelus]] he remains in the team participating in the [[LLA 2019 Closing]] where the team was first in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[LLA 2019 Closing Playoffs]] the team reached the final facing [[All Knights]] winning 3-0, qualifying for the World Cup. Already in the World Cup the team was in group B facing [[DetonatioN FocusMe]] from Japan and [[Splyce]] from Europe, where the team was second in the group phase, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the playoffs the team faces [[Hong Kong Attitude]] losing 1-3.

== Trivia ==
* His favorite champions are {{ci|Lee Sin}} and {{ci|Ezreal}}.
* Reached Challenger in all American servers (LAS, BR, LAN, and NA).
* Has played bot, jungle, and mid competitively.
* He would love to play against [[Deft]].

=== Individual Awards ===
* LLA player with the most MVPs in the split x2 (Opening 2020, Closing 2021)
